profiles.title: KisanScore agri-credit risk model retraining
description: KisanScore v3 is the crop-season credit risk model of a Pune-based non-banking financial company that lends to smallholder farmers across Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh. The model is a gradient-boosted tree ensemble trained on 38 million historical repayment records, mandi price feeds, and district-level rainfall data, and it prices roughly 400,000 loan applications each season.

The quarterly retraining run executes on the company's own eight-node CPU cluster in its Pune data centre. Rack-level PDU meters and per-socket RAPL counters were logged for the full run, and western regional grid emission factors were applied to the metered kilowatt-hours. Market-based figures reflect the renewable energy certificates the lender retires against its data-centre load.

The submission covers the complete hyperparameter search and final fit for the 2026 kharif-season model. Feature-store serving, training-data storage, and the loan officers' scoring interface sit outside the declared boundary.

boundary_json.description: Quarterly retraining of the KisanScore v3 gradient-boosted ensemble, including the hyperparameter search and final fit, on the lender's Pune CPU cluster.

assessment.measurement_source: rack PDU meters and per-socket RAPL counters

profiles.rationale: Metered PDU and RAPL evidence scores 0.93, the measured class midpoint, in the measured band, and 38.3 kgCO2e for a classical training run sits well inside the low tier. The (low, measured) cell resolves to go with nothing to block approval. ENV-4 is missing only because a per-request efficiency figure does not apply to a training-run functional unit.
profiles.mitigation_design: Go cell: no mitigation required; approval is not blocking.

profiles.title: LexRetrieve statute and case-law RAG search
description: LexRetrieve is the retrieval service behind a Dublin-based legal research product used by law firms in Ireland and the Netherlands. Each query embeds the user question with a compact bi-encoder, retrieves candidate passages from a statute and case-law index, and returns re-ranked citations. Roughly twelve million queries were served in the June 2026 window.

Energy and carbon figures come from the cloud provider's carbon footprint export for the tagged retrieval pods, which reports kilowatt-hours with Irish grid intensity for the location figure and the provider's green-tariff residual mix for the market figure. Engineering cross-checked the export against pod CPU-seconds; the residual uncertainty is dominated by the provider's shared-node allocation, which customers cannot audit.
The declared boundary covers embedding, index search, and re-ranking for production queries. The nightly index rebuild is assessed separately and is excluded here.

boundary_json.description: Production query path of the LexRetrieve service: query embedding, index search, and re-ranking for the June 2026 window (about 12 million queries).

assessment.measurement_source: cloud provider carbon footprint export for the retrieval pods

profiles.rationale: Provider-reported figures score 0.50, the vendor_reported class midpoint, in the estimated band, and 0.0004 kgCO2e per 1000 requests is comfortably low impact. The (low, estimated) cell resolves to go, and the profile carries full ENV-1..6 coverage.
profiles.mitigation_design: Go cell: no mitigation required; approval is not blocking.

profiles.title: TalentSift resume screening ranker
description: TalentSift ranks incoming resumes for enterprise recruiting teams at a Denver-based HR software vendor. A distilled transformer scores each resume against the job requisition; about eight million screening requests were processed in the June 2026 window across two US production regions.

No energy instrumentation exists yet. A platform engineer produced a spreadsheet estimate from model FLOPs, an assumed accelerator utilisation of 40 percent, and a national average grid factor. The team did not compute a market-based figure, and although instrumentation options are being discussed, no owner or target date has been attached to any of them.

boundary_json.description: Resume scoring API across the two US production regions for the June 2026 window (about 8 million screening requests).
boundary_json.assumptions: National average grid factor; accelerator utilisation assumed at 40 percent.

profiles.rationale: A manual FLOP worksheet caps evidence at 0.30, inside the unknown band, while impact stays low, so the (low, unknown) cell returns conditional_go. With no dated mitigation and no exception the release is approval-blocking. The missing market-based figure also leaves ENV-3 uncovered.
profiles.mitigation_design: Conditional_go deliberately left without a dated mitigation or exception: approval_blocking is true (contrast with P10).

profiles.title: TriageAssist clinical intake fine-tune
description: TriageAssist is a clinical intake assistant for a hospital network that operates 14 facilities across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. The network fine-tuned an open 8-billion-parameter model on de-identified triage notes and nurse-line transcripts so the assistant can suggest acuity levels and department routing in English and Telugu.

The two-week fine-tune ran on a metered eight-GPU cluster in the network's Hyderabad facility. Rack PDU energy logs supplied kilowatt-hours, southern regional grid factors supplied the location figure, and market figures net off the facility's partial renewable certificates. The AI platform team has signed a dated plan to move the next fine-tuning cycle to the Bengaluru colocation covered by a solar power purchase agreement.

boundary_json.description: Supervised fine-tune of an open 8B model on de-identified triage notes on the Hyderabad eight-GPU cluster, including evaluation passes.

mitigations_json.description: Move the next fine-tuning cycle to the Bengaluru colocation covered by the solar power purchase agreement and re-run this assessment on metered evidence.

profiles.rationale: Metered fine-tune evidence scores 0.93 in the measured band and 1350 kgCO2e sits mid-range in the medium tier, so the (medium, measured) cell returns conditional_go. The dated solar-PPA migration plan documents mitigation, so the conditional release is not approval-blocking.
profiles.mitigation_design: Dated mitigation documented: approval_blocking is false.

profiles.title: UPI fraud scoring service
description: A Mumbai payments company scores UPI transactions for fraud in real time with a gradient-boosted ensemble backed by a graph feature service. The June 2026 window covered about 45 million scoring requests across two cloud regions during peak festival-season traffic.

Environmental figures come from the cloud provider's sustainability dashboard, which reports location-based and market-based carbon for the tagged workloads but does not expose the underlying kilowatt-hours, and its methodology is not independently auditable. The platform team claims high confidence in the numbers, but the evidence class remains vendor-reported.
A dated migration of the scoring fleet to the provider's hydro-backed region, with the metered energy export API enabled, is committed for November and is already in progress.

boundary_json.description: Real-time UPI fraud scoring across two production cloud regions for the June 2026 window (about 45 million requests), as tagged in the provider sustainability dashboard.

mitigations_json.description: Migrate the scoring fleet to the provider's hydro-backed region and enable the metered energy export API for direct kilowatt-hour evidence.

profiles.rationale: The claimed 0.88 confidence is recorded but not used: vendor-reported dashboard evidence is scored at the 0.50 class midpoint, landing in the estimated band, while 0.0038 kgCO2e per 1000 requests is medium impact. The (medium, estimated) cell returns conditional_go and the dated hydro-region migration keeps it from blocking approval. The undisclosed kilowatt-hours leave ENV-2 uncovered.
profiles.mitigation_design: Dated mitigation documented: approval_blocking is false (contrast with P12).

profiles.title: Workspace chat assistant serving
description: A productivity software company embeds a conversational assistant in its flagship product for drafting, summarising, and answering workspace questions. The assistant serves a 70-billion-parameter model behind a token-streaming API; June 2026 traffic was about 2.1 billion generated tokens across three serving regions.

The sustainability lead assembled the June estimate manually from published per-token energy figures for comparable 70B-class deployments, an assumed PUE of 1.3, and a blended grid factor across the three regions. There is no telemetry from the serving fleet, and billing data cannot be decomposed to the assistant workload. The team acknowledges the figure could move materially in either direction.

boundary_json.description: Token generation for the embedded workspace assistant across three serving regions in June 2026 (about 2.1 billion generated tokens).
boundary_json.assumptions: Per-token energy from published figures for comparable 70B-class deployments; PUE assumed at 1.3; blended grid factor across regions.

assessment.measurement_source: sustainability-team estimate from published per-token figures

profiles.rationale: The manual estimate scores 0.30, in the unknown band, while 4.6 kgCO2e per million tokens is medium impact, so the (medium, unknown) cell returns no_go. Full ENV-1..6 coverage cannot rescue evidence that is too weak for a medium-impact release, and a no_go always blocks approval.
profiles.mitigation_design: No_go cell: approval_blocking is true regardless of mitigation.

profiles.title: Biomedical domain LLM pretraining run
description: A US biomedical research laboratory pretrained a 13-billion-parameter domain language model on curated literature, clinical guidelines, and licensed textbook corpora to support downstream extraction and evidence-synthesis tools. The run processed roughly 500 billion tokens over six weeks on the laboratory's HPC partition.

Node-level IPMI power telemetry and facility PUE were logged for the full run. Hourly average regional grid intensity supplied the location figure, and the laboratory's wind power purchase agreement is reflected in the market figure. Operations has signed a dated plan to place the next pretraining cycle in the overnight low-carbon window using the carbon-aware scheduler and to publish per-checkpoint energy budgets.

boundary_json.description: Full pretraining run of the 13B biomedical language model on the laboratory HPC partition, including checkpoint evaluation jobs.

mitigations_json.description: Schedule the next pretraining cycle in the overnight low-carbon window using the carbon-aware scheduler and publish per-checkpoint energy budgets.

profiles.rationale: IPMI-metered training evidence scores 0.93 in the measured band and 62,320 kgCO2e is high impact, so the (high, measured) cell returns conditional_go. The dated scheduling and energy-budget plan documents mitigation, so approval is not blocked.
profiles.mitigation_design: Dated mitigation documented: approval_blocking is false (contrast with the P11 exception path in the same cell).

profiles.title: Indic multilingual LLM continued pretraining
description: A Bengaluru startup ran continued pretraining of a 7-billion-parameter multilingual model across ten Indic languages, positioning it for government-service chat and voice interfaces. The five-week run used a rented GPU cluster located in a coal-heavy grid region.

The startup did not meter energy. Its figures come from the GPU rental provider's monthly sustainability statement, which reports energy and emissions per tenant from the provider's own facility metering; the method and meter data are not open to audit. The startup discloses retired verified carbon units covering roughly the estimated footprint and treats that purchase as its primary environmental answer. Mitigation for the next run is described as planned, but no owner or target date has been documented.

boundary_json.description: Continued pretraining of the 7B multilingual model across ten Indic languages on a rented GPU cluster.
boundary_json.assumptions: Energy and emissions as stated in the provider's tenant sustainability statement; provider method not open to audit.

assessment.measurement_source: GPU rental provider monthly sustainability statement

profiles.rationale: The provider-reported statement scores 0.50, the vendor_reported class midpoint, in the estimated band and 28,623 kgCO2e is high impact, so the (high, estimated) cell returns no_go. Retired carbon units are disclosed but never improve confidence, tier, or the gate, and the absence of a dated mitigation is moot for a no_go, which always blocks approval.
profiles.mitigation_design: No_go cell: approval_blocking is true; disclosed offsets deliberately do not rescue the gate.

profiles.title: Third-party document-intelligence API
description: An enterprise contracts team routes scanned agreements through a third-party document-intelligence API that performs OCR and generates structured summaries with a large generative model. About 600 million generated tokens were consumed in June 2026, and the vendor operates the model as a managed black box across undisclosed regions.

The vendor declined to disclose energy, carbon, hardware, or region information, citing commercial confidentiality, and publishes no sustainability documentation for the service. The efficiency figure on file is the team's own worst-case screening replication using an open model of assumed similar size on previous-generation accelerators; the vendor has neither confirmed nor corrected it. No uncertainty quantification accompanies the submission because there is no disclosure to quantify.

boundary_json.description: Contract OCR and structured summarisation through the managed third-party API for the June 2026 window (about 600 million generated tokens).
boundary_json.assumptions: Efficiency figure is the team's worst-case screening replication with an open model of assumed similar size; the vendor has not confirmed it.

assessment.notes: Vendor declined energy, carbon, hardware, and region disclosure citing commercial confidentiality.

profiles.rationale: The vendor discloses nothing, so provenance is unknown and confidence is forced to 0.0, which returns no_go before any matrix lookup. The worst-case screening figure of 18 kgCO2e per million generated tokens tiers the workload high, but the undisclosed evidence drives the label. Coverage exists only for the boundary, the efficiency figure, and the vacuously satisfied mitigation control.
profiles.mitigation_design: No_go cell: approval_blocking is true; undisclosed provenance forces confidence 0.0.

profiles.title: Digital lending pre-qualification scorer
description: A digital lending non-banking financial company pre-qualifies personal-loan applicants with a logistic scorecard refined by a small gradient-boosted model. The Chennai region deployment scored about six million applications in June 2026.

The platform team estimated energy from container CPU allocation and the southern grid factor in a documented worksheet; no measurement tooling is deployed yet. Unlike earlier submissions from the same team, this one carries a dated instrumentation commitment: CodeCarbon on the scoring containers, with a re-submission on tool-estimated evidence by mid-September.

boundary_json.description: Personal-loan pre-qualification scoring in the Chennai region for the June 2026 window (about 6 million applications).
boundary_json.assumptions: Energy estimated from container CPU allocation and the southern grid factor.

mitigations_json.description: Deploy CodeCarbon instrumentation on the scoring containers and re-submit this assessment on tool-estimated evidence.

profiles.rationale: A documented manual worksheet scores 0.30, in the unknown band, with low impact, so the (low, unknown) cell returns conditional_go. Unlike P03, the dated CodeCarbon instrumentation commitment documents mitigation, so the conditional release is not approval-blocking.
profiles.mitigation_design: Dated evidence-improvement mitigation documented: approval_blocking is false (contrast with P03).

profiles.title: Marketplace search re-ranking LLM serving
description: A global marketplace re-ranks search results with a large language model that scores the candidate set for every query. The Singapore and Frankfurt fleets consumed about 2.4 billion scored tokens in June 2026, and relevance gains from the ranker directly drive gross merchandise volume.

The serving fleet is fully metered: smart-PDU telemetry is aggregated per model endpoint, and location and market figures are computed from hourly grid data. Per-token carbon is high because every query fans out to score dozens of candidates on previous-generation accelerators.

Rather than a dated efficiency mitigation, the VP of Platform Engineering signed a formal exception recording the contracted fourth-quarter migration to next-generation hardware, with quarterly review until the exception expires at year end.

boundary_json.description: LLM re-ranking of search candidate sets on the Singapore and Frankfurt fleets for the June 2026 window (about 2.4 billion scored tokens).

exception.rationale: Accelerator fleet migration to next-generation hardware is contracted for Q4 2026; interim operation approved with quarterly review.

profiles.rationale: Fully metered serving evidence scores 0.93 in the measured band and 14.5 kgCO2e per million tokens is high impact, so the (high, measured) cell returns conditional_go. There is no dated mitigation, but the signed exception with owner, expiry, and rationale satisfies the gate, so approval is not blocked.
profiles.mitigation_design: Owned exception instead of a dated mitigation: approval_blocking is false via the exception path (contrast with P07).

profiles.title: Enterprise semantic embedding pipeline
description: A Toronto analytics vendor maintains semantic search over customer document stores. A nightly pipeline embeds new and changed content with a 350-million-parameter encoder, processing about 38 million embedding requests in June 2026 across two regions, many of them long multi-page documents.

Energy and carbon figures come from the cloud provider's per-service carbon report for the embedding gateway, which allocates the provider's figures to the tagged service with assumptions customers cannot audit. Off-peak batching and a distilled encoder are both under discussion as reduction options, but neither has an owner or a target date, and no exception has been requested from the review board.

boundary_json.description: Nightly and incremental embedding of customer document stores with the 350M encoder across two regions for the June 2026 window (about 38 million embedding requests).

profiles.rationale: Provider-reported figures score 0.50, the vendor_reported class midpoint, in the estimated band and 0.004 kgCO2e per 1000 requests is medium impact, so the (medium, estimated) cell returns conditional_go. The batching and distillation ideas carry no owner or date and no exception was requested, so the release is approval-blocking, unlike P05.
profiles.mitigation_design: Conditional_go with undated intentions only: approval_blocking is true (contrast with P05).
